notes: Mesh consists of multiple separate wooden elements

blind.description: A stylized rustic wooden bench or sawhorse trestle bench. It features a thick rectangular plank seat resting on two pairs of splayed legs braced by horizontal wooden rails/stretchers. The surfaces are solid, cleanly modeled, and textured with warm brown wood grain in a hand-painted or stylized art style.
blind.from_above: A horizontal brown rectangular wooden plank with the tips of four splayed legs protruding symmetrically from beneath the sides.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 to 2 feet tall (around one-third the height of the figure) and roughly 3.5 feet long.
